source: make an very very very long obbys tiger themed and don't just make it jumps make it wallhops and more

image_prompt.text: A very long chain of platforms spaced to the physics limits, forming the ordered route through the course
Wall scrambles and wallhop sections, trusses and tightropes, so progress is not only jumping
Significantly tighter alternate routes that skip ahead for skilled players
Long horizontal jumps, trampoline boosts and stepped vertical platforms, present but not the whole course
an extremely long course - the user asked for length three times over

notes: Glitch Obby caveat: gaps are set deliberately beyond the documented limits and cannot be validated by P6, so the structure is author-supplied.
Shape was a close call. Wallhops point at the glitch/tower preset, but 'very very very long' may mean a flat course extended horizontally rather than a spiral.
Course length has no option to carry it and survives only as this note.

open_questions.ask: Long as in a tall tower you spiral up, or long as in a flat course that just keeps going?
'And more' beyond wallhops - moving platforms, disappearing platforms, tightropes, conveyors?

coverage_missing.ask: Long as in a tall tower you spiral up, or long as in a flat course that just keeps going?
'And more' beyond wallhops - which other obstacle kinds do you want?
Roughly how long is 'very very very long' - a few minutes of play, or a marathon course?

answers.ask: Long as in a tall tower you spiral up, or long as in a flat course that just keeps going?
answers.answer: Make it a very long flat course that keeps going, with tiger-themed sections along the way.

answers.ask: 'And more' beyond wallhops - moving platforms, disappearing platforms, tightropes, conveyors?
answers.answer: Include moving platforms, disappearing platforms, tightropes, and conveyors alongside wallhops so it is not only simple jumps.
